title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten documented destinations on campus-adjacent Columbia corridors, each with one specific reason to stop.

cards.title: Pizza on Ninth Street
cards.subtitle: Ninth Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk to 225 S. Ninth Street and use the downtown location as a food stop while exploring the blocks bordering campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Shakespeare's location on the Ninth Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Columbia Convention and Visitors Bureau lists Shakespeare's Pizza – Downtown at 225 S. Ninth Street.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Rotating gallery exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Ninth Street corridor
cards.notes: At 207 S. Ninth Street, check the current exhibition listing before you go and leave time to view the gallery's displayed work.
cards.short_summary: An art gallery presenting changing local and national artists' work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Columbia Art League Gallery is listed at 207 S. Ninth Street and curates six or seven exhibitions each year.
cards.access_notes: Gallery access and exhibition schedules can change; check its current information before visiting.

cards.title: Independent film at Hitt and Cherry
cards.subtitle: Hitt Street corridor
cards.notes: Find the cinema at 10 Hitt Street and consult the current program; seating opens 30 minutes before a showtime when ready.
cards.short_summary: A cinema whose mission centers independent film and media art.
cards.evidence_claim: Ragtag Cinema is at 10 Hitt Street and states that its mission is to champion independent film and media art.
cards.access_notes: Ticketed screenings; the venue says seating opens 30 minutes before showtime, subject to cleaning readiness.

cards.title: Library headquarters on Broadway
cards.subtitle: West Broadway corridor
cards.notes: Use the library at 100 W. Broadway as a documented public-library stop; look up its current calendar or services before setting out.
cards.short_summary: The Columbia Public Library serves as Daniel Boone Regional Library headquarters.
cards.evidence_claim: The Columbia Public Library, at 100 W. Broadway, is the headquarters of the Daniel Boone Regional Library.
cards.access_notes: Check the library's current opening times and event details before visiting.

cards.title: Ice cream on Ninth
cards.subtitle: Ninth Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 21 S. Ninth Street for the shop's documented changing flavor selection, then continue through The District on foot.
cards.short_summary: A Ninth Street ice-cream shop with listed specialty flavors.
cards.evidence_claim: Sparky's Homemade Ice Cream is listed at 21 S. Ninth Street and describes flavors including honey lavender and mandarin-orange dark chocolate.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; ask staff about current flavors and ingredient needs.

cards.title: Regional craft gallery
cards.subtitle: Ninth Street corridor
cards.notes: Browse the three-room gallery at 13 S. Ninth Street, where the listing describes craft work by artists from Missouri and nearby states.
cards.short_summary: A three-room gallery for regional traditional and contemporary craft.
cards.evidence_claim: Bluestem Missouri Crafts is at 13 S. Ninth Street and its three-room gallery features work by more than 300 artists and craftspeople.
cards.access_notes: Retail gallery; confirm current opening details before visiting.

cards.title: Coffee in Alley A
cards.subtitle: Alley A corridor between Ninth and Tenth streets
cards.notes: Use the shop's Alley A location between Ninth and Tenth as a brief coffee stop, choosing from its documented espresso and hand-brew methods.
cards.short_summary: A specialty coffee shop and roastery tucked into Alley A.
cards.evidence_claim: Shortwave Coffee describes itself as a specialty coffee bar and roastery located in Alley A between Ninth and Tenth streets.
cards.access_notes: Food and drink purchase required; confirm current service details before visiting.

cards.title: Breakfast on Fourth Street
cards.subtitle: Fourth Street corridor at Broadway
cards.notes: At 22 S. Fourth Street, make this a breakfast stop and confirm the day's operating details with the diner before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway-area diner listed for breakfast and more.
cards.evidence_claim: Broadway Diner is listed at 22 S. Fourth Street, and its visitor listing describes breakfast and more served through 2 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; verify current operating times directly before visiting.

cards.title: Pizza on Cherry Street
cards.subtitle: Cherry Street corridor
cards.notes: Locate Pizza Tree at 909 Cherry Street and treat it as a simple downtown food stop while walking the Cherry and Hitt blocks.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza destination on the Cherry Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Tree is listed at 909 Cherry Street in downtown Columbia.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; confirm current service details before visiting.

cards.title: Studios in North Village
cards.subtitle: Orr Street corridor in the North Village Arts District
cards.notes: Head to 106 Orr Street and use the gallery as an art-focused stop while continuing through the North Village Arts District.
cards.short_summary: A named gallery stop in the North Village Arts District.
cards.evidence_claim: The Columbia Convention and Visitors Bureau identifies Orr Street Studios Gallery at 106 Orr Street as a notable spot in the North Village Arts District.
cards.access_notes: Check the studio/gallery's current public access details before visiting.
